title: Future continuous and future perfect · 将来进行时与将来完成时
pattern: will be + V-ing (将来某时正在进行)  ·  will have + past participle (将来某时前已完成)
summary: 将来进行时说“那个时间点正在做”，将来完成时说“那个时间点之前已经做完”。
explanation: **将来进行时** 的结构是 **will be + 动词-ing**，表示“将来某个时间点正在进行的动作”：At 8 o'clock tomorrow, I **will be sitting** in the exam room.（明天八点，我正坐在考场里。）重点不是动作什么时候开始，而是“那个时刻它正在发生”。
**将来完成时** 的结构是 **will have + 过去分词**，表示“到将来某个时间点为止，动作已经完成”：By next June, I **will have finished** my master's degree.（到明年六月，我的硕士学位就已经修完了。）常用 by + 时间（by Friday、by next year）或 by the time + 从句作为时间界限。
两者的时间标志词很重要：at this time tomorrow、at 9 p.m. tomorrow、this time next week 通常搭配将来进行时；by next year、by then、by the time you get home 则常搭配将来完成时。中文“到……为止”往往对应完成时，“那时候正在……”往往对应进行时。
在 **by the time、when、after、as soon as** 引导的时间状语从句中，要用一般现在时代替将来时：By the time you **get** home, the kids **will have gone** to bed.（不说 By the time you will get home。）主句用将来完成时，从句用一般现在时。
注意：will be doing 有时也可以表示“按计划或正常情况会发生”（I will be seeing him tomorrow anyway.），但在练习中更常见的仍是“某一时刻正在进行”的含义。学会根据时间状语判断，就不容易混淆这两种时态。
mistakes: ✗ At 8 o'clock tomorrow, I will work. → ✓ At 8 o'clock tomorrow, I will be working. 中文“那时候正在工作”要用将来进行时 will be working，不能只用一般将来时。
✗ By next June, I will finish my degree. → ✓ By next June, I will have finished my degree. 表示“到某时为止已经完成”要用将来完成时 will have finished。
✗ By the time you will arrive, I will have finished dinner. → ✓ By the time you arrive, I will have finished dinner. by the time 引导的时间从句里要用一般现在时，不能用 will。
✗ By next Monday, I will have be finished the project. → ✓ By next Monday, I will have finished the project. have 后面直接接过去分词 finished，不能再加 be。

examples.text: This time next week, we will be lying on a beach in Thailand.
examples.translation: 下周这个时候，我们将躺在泰国的海滩上。

examples.text: At 9 p.m. tomorrow, she will be flying to Tokyo.
examples.translation: 明天晚上九点，她应该正在飞往东京的航班上。

examples.text: By next June, I will have finished my master's degree.
examples.translation: 到明年六月，我的硕士学位就已经修完了。

examples.text: By the time you get home, the kids will have gone to bed.
examples.translation: 等你回到家时，孩子们应该已经睡了。
examples.note: by the time 从句用一般现在时。

examples.text: Will you be working late tonight?
examples.note: 将来进行时的疑问句：Will + 主语 + be + V-ing。

examples.text: By 2030, many cities will have banned petrol cars.
examples.translation: 到2030年，许多城市将已经禁止燃油车。

examples.text: At this time tomorrow, I will be sitting in the exam room.
examples.translation: 明天这个时候，我正坐在考场里。

exercises.sentence: At this time tomorrow, I ___ to Berlin.
exercises.translation: 明天这个时候，我应该正在飞往柏林。
options: flew
have flown
will be flying
fly
exercises.explanation: “那个时间点正在进行”用将来进行时 will be flying。

exercises.sentence: By next June, I ___ my degree.
exercises.translation: 到明年六月，我就已经修完学位了。
options: finished
will be finishing
will have finished
have finished
exercises.explanation: by next June 表示到某时为止已完成，用将来完成时 will have finished。

exercises.sentence: At 8 o'clock tomorrow, she ___ for the bus.
exercises.translation: 明天八点，她正在等公交车。
options: waits
has waited
waited
will be waiting
exercises.explanation: tomorrow 的某个具体时刻正在进行，用 will be waiting。

exercises.source: 到明年六月，我们就已经搬进新房子了。
options: By next June, we will move into the new house.
By next June, we will have moved into the new house.
By next June, we will be moving into the new house.
By next June, we will have move into the new house.
exercises.explanation: “已经搬进”是到某时已完成的动作，用 will have moved。

exercises.source: 明天这个时候，我们应该正在飞往上海的飞机上。
options: At this time tomorrow, we flew to Shanghai.
At this time tomorrow, we will have flown to Shanghai.
At this time tomorrow, we was flying to Shanghai.
At this time tomorrow, we will be flying to Shanghai.
exercises.explanation: “正在”的将来时点用将来进行时 will be flying。

exercises.source: 等你到家的时候，孩子们应该已经睡了。
options: By the time you get home, the kids will have gone to bed.
By the time you will get home, the kids will have gone to bed.
By the time you get home, the kids will go to bed.
By the time you get home, the kids will be gone to bed.
exercises.explanation: by the time 从句用一般现在时 get，主句用将来完成时 will have gone。

options: At this time next year, I will be studying in London.
By 2028, the company will have opened ten new stores.
By next Monday, I will be finish the project.
exercises.explanation: will be 后面要接 V-ing，应写成 will be finishing；但表示“到周一已完成”时应使用 will have finished。

options: When you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.
When you will arrive, I will have cooked dinner.
By the time you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.
exercises.explanation: when 引导的时间从句中不能用 will，应写成 When you arrive。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 明天这个时候，我们应该正在长城上散步。
exercises.explanation: 时间状语 at this time tomorrow 加 will be + V-ing 表示将来某时正在进行。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.explanation: by next year 搭配将来完成时 will have saved，表示到那时为止已完成。
